Card sections that often contain it: Intended Use, Use Cases, Downstream Use

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Chat assistants (Le Chat), coding agents (Vibe / Vibe CLI), and agentic systems with native function calling/tool use and JSON output; also multimodal (text+image input) applications
quotes: Mistral Medium 3.5 replaces its predecessor Mistral Medium 3.1 and Magistral in Le Chat. It also replaces Devstral 2 in our
Reasoning effort is configurable per request, so the same model can answer a quick chat reply or work through a complex agentic run.
**Agentic**: Best-in-class agentic capabilities with native function calling and JSON output.
Due to its stronger agentic capabilities, Mistral Medium 3.5 replaces Devstral 2 in our coding agent, Vibe CLI.
